title: Faithful crack image synthesis from evolutionary pixel-level annotations via latent semantic diffusion model (LSDM)
mechanism: Latent semantic diffusion renders crack images from pixel-level annotations, and a heuristic crack-evolution step grows and branches existing annotations into richer new masks.
adaptation: Evolve skeletonised crack labels; grown cracks that isolate a region from all busbars yield new inactive masks; render with a pixel renderer or on GDI canvases rather than the latent model for 1-2 px cracks. HF demo QinLei086/LSDM stated in abstract, not opened.
min_experiment: PF + evolved masks rendered vs PF + original masks rendered by the same renderer. Metric CV inactive IoU and test crack relR@2. Kill: < +0.01 on both.
evidence: R: crack segmentation datasets; LSDM + evolution beats traditional augmentation and other generators (no numbers in abstract).
